thought.text: The mount landed at host root (relative to compose file) — the actual workspace is at `/workspaces/workspace` inside. Let me bind-mount it into place:

reasoning_content:
I see the issue — the mount path is being resolved relative to the compose file's location, so `../../..` from `.devcontainer/default/` points to the filesystem root instead of the actual workspace directory. That's why the container is mounting the host root at `/workspaces`, and the `whoami` output seems incomplete.

To fix this, I need to either copy the workspace into a container that's explicitly mounted at `/workspaces/workspace`, or create a bind mount from `/workspaces` to the correct location inside the container.

action.command: docker inspect zammad-devcontainer-devcontainer-1 --format '{{range .Mounts}}{{.Source}} -> {{.Destination}}{{"\n"}}{{end}}'; echo ===; docker run -d --name ws-fix --entrypoint sh -c 'sleep 1' alpine 2>/dev/null || docker image ls | head; ls / | head
